blocks.x: (Talks with Ken) How much time we got left on this one? We only did five minutes? You said it was twenty before.
Twenty minus five is fifteen, sir. I hate to break the news to you. In my world, twenty minus five is fifteen. But you live in that other world, so maybe you know something I don’t.
I don’t know. That world, over there.
That was five minutes? I guess he’s going to get his Sibelius seven now.
I got to get this shit, man. I got to get this done.
Are you still rolling? I thought you’d put it on break ….
